metadata.name: slab
metadata.description: Slab catalog program for MagicBlock Ephemeral Rollups

instructions.name: crank_commit
docs: Stamp catalog_root, then MagicIntent-commit with the delegated Slab as payer.
No user signer — Magic invokes this crank. Wallet payers fail InvalidWritableAccount.

instructions.name: delegate_index
docs: Delegate one Index after `prepare_index`. Does not touch Slab or Catalog.

instructions.name: delegate_page
docs: Delegate one PagePtr after `prepare_page`. Does not touch Slab or Catalog.

instructions.name: prepare_index
docs: Create an empty Index PDA on L1. Slab may already be DLP-owned.

instructions.name: prepare_page
docs: Create an empty PagePtr PDA on L1. Call again for page_no 1, 2, …

instructions.name: prepare_rel
docs: First table helper: Index + page 0. Extra pages use `prepare_page` only.

instructions.name: realloc_catalog
docs: Grow Catalog from 16 to 32 relation slots. Call on L1 (or ER if already delegated).

instructions.name: schedule_commit_crank
docs: Schedule crank_commit on the ER. Send this transaction to the ER, not L1.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.msg: 42601 syntax_error: statement is not in the v0 SQL subset

errors.name: InvalidPrimaryKey
errors.msg: primary key attribute is out of range

errors.name: InvalidIdentifier
errors.msg: identifier is empty or longer than the catalog field

errors.name: InvalidRelOid
errors.msg: relation oid must be the next catalog oid

errors.name: InvalidPointer
errors.msg: txid must be a 32-64 byte Irys id, and hash must be non-zero

errors.name: InvalidDelegationRecord
errors.msg: delegation record or magic fee vault does not match the validator

errors.name: CatalogGrown
errors.msg: catalog is already grown to 32 tables

types.name: Catalog
docs: Header + 16 relations at init (10 KiB create cap). `realloc_catalog` adds 16 more.

types.name: Index
docs: PK or secondary index. Cap fits the 10 KiB inner-ix create limit.

types.name: PagePtr
docs: Pointer to an 8 KiB page on Irys. Row bytes never live here.

fields.name: idx_mask
docs: Bit i set means column i has an Index PDA.

fields.name: catalog_root
docs: sha256 of the Catalog account bytes at the last commit.

types.name: SqlStmt
docs: Structured SQL. The proxy parses Postgres text. The program never sees JOIN.
